verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains only thin, title-level first-party signals of triage: an 'Issue Status' docs page under states-triage, 'Ownership Rules' for assigning owners, a bulk-mutate issues API, and MCP and CLI claims of triaging and issue management. Nothing in the pack describes the individual actions or the regression behavior. Missing for 10: documented resolve/ignore/snooze actions, explicit owner assignment workflow, automatic reopening of resolved issues on regression, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can triage issues — assign an owner, resolve, ignore, or snooze — and the platform reopens a resolved issue automatically when it regresses
